text:
𝗣𝗔𝗞 𝗔 𝗡𝗘𝗘𝗗 𝟭𝟳𝟯! 🏏

Chasing 233 v Bangladesh A in the Rising Stars semi-final, Pakistan A were 60/2 after 14.4 overs.
Shahadat's 103* had rescued BAN A from 15/4.

Who reaches the final? 👇
#RisingStars #Cricket

𝗣𝗔𝗞 𝗔 𝗞𝗢 𝗖𝗛𝗔𝗛𝗜𝗬𝗘 𝟭𝟳𝟯! 🏏🔥

👉 Rising Stars semi-final: Bangladesh A ne 232/8 banaye
👉 Shahadat Hossain ne 15/4 se sambhal kar 103* thoka
👉 Pakistan A 14.4 over mein 60/2 the, jeet ke liye 35.2 over mein 173 chahiye

Final mein Sri Lanka A se kaun milega?

#CricketKiBaat #RisingStars #Cricket
